dna.opening: a silver camera drone rises into a dark studio as a glowing blue wireframe, rotors spinning, and a scan line turns it solid under the hook "Why is your site slow abroad?"
dna.bigMoment: the camera pulls back from a stuck browser, a silver wireframe globe rises beneath it and edge nodes light one by one, firing blue arcs into the page until it snaps in
dna.ground: graphite studio with cold silver beams, electric blue and ice glows, an ice grid floor with a blue pool, dust and bokeh, cold grade
dna.music: cold cinematic electronic with a ticking pulse, a held breath, a bright synth swell on the globe and a clean resolve, about 110 BPM
